text:
maria (support): Heads up — multiple customers reporting intermittent 503s from the hosted API in us-west-2, starting ~2026-03-17 15:04 UTC. Looks like upstream inference workers are crashing. tagging @ryan and @lee :disappointed:

sre-bot: alert: upstream-runner pool=nearline-prod host=gw-tn-54 severity=critical event=process_exit signal=11 exit_code=139 count=12 in 2m

ryan (oncall): i'm looking. which customers impacted? any auth failures reported or only 503s?

maria (support): main hits from Acme & HelixFinance. customers see 503 -> client retries -> increased latencies. no auth error codes, just gateway 503s. CS already messaged Acme.

lee (infra): pulled node metrics: gw-tn-54, gw-tn-55, gw-tn-56 show gpu mem at ~98% then immediate process SIGSEGV. nvml logs show GPU reset at time of crash. suspect OOM leading to segfault in attention kernel.

ryan (oncall): ok repro on a small cluster: run a heavy-auth burst with multiple toolcalls + long context (we used 40k tokens) and large batch size 16 for embed+generate -> we trigger exit.

ryan (oncall): attaching minimal repro command i used locally (staging):
```bash
# synthetic load to reproduce
ablate-bench --profile=auth-heavy --qps=120 --batch=16 --ctx=40000 --duration=90s
```

lee (infra): from container logs (short):
```
[2026-03-17T15:04:12Z] infer_runner: kv_prefetch: prefetch_size=1.2GB
[2026-03-17T15:04:12Z] attention: allocate 3.6GB workspace
[2026-03-17T15:04:12Z] nvml: GPU 0: out of memory, resetting device
[2026-03-17T15:04:12Z] runtime: segfault at 0x00000000 (signal 11)
```

maria (support): customers asking for ETA. we need mitigation / rollback plan.

ryan (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) reduce batch sizes and limit parallel toolcalls at the gateway 2) route heavy auth tier to fallback model variant with lower memory footprint 3) temporarily scale up dedicated pool with headroom. rolling a config change to throttle high-concurrency auth routes now.

lee (infra): opened a temp firewall to shift new sessions away from gw-tn-5[4-6], live draining them. also creating an autoscaler override to add 4 nodes with larger GPUs for headroom.

maria (support): noted. i'll update CS and the status page: "Partial degradation for hosted inference in us-west-2; mitigation in progress" :thumbsup:

ryan (oncall): root-cause hypothesis: kv-prefetch + large attention workspace under heavy toolcall parallelism causes memory ballooning then nvml reset; the kernel handles corrupted pointers post-reset leading to segfault. need a proper repro-inspect on core dump.

lee (infra): collected coredump and GPU debug dump. paths:
- /var/log/core/infer_runner.gw-tn-54.7259998888.core
- /var/log/nv-dumps/gpu0_reset_7259998888.tar.gz

lee (infra): quick triage: coredump backtrace shows crash in attention kernel code path near index remap. will run in cuda-gdb on staging image.

ryan (oncall): for next steps:
- eng-ml to run signed-off reproducer under debug build (ASAN/UBSAN if possible)
- runtime team to add a guard: check nvml device reset and abort gracefuly before kernel resume
- rollout policy: keep fallback routing until patch validated

maria (support): CS wants a customer-facing repro summary and a TTR estimate. can we commit to ~2-3 hours for mitigation and 24-48h for a patch?

ryan (oncall): mitigation ETA: 30-45m (drain+throttle+extra nodes). patch ETA depends on root cause, but provisional 48h is reasonable.

lee (infra): logging additional safe-mode toggle to prevent large-batch scheduling on hosts with <10% free GPU mem. pushing config now.

ops-voice: DeployBot: rolling config throttle-auth-heavy to nearline-prod (3/3 succeeded)

maria (support): updated status page and replied to Acme: we are mitigating, reduced impact expected in ~30m.

ryan (oncall): tracking follow-ups: eng-ml assign -> run reproducer w/ debug kernels; runtime -> add NVML reset detection + graceful abort; infra -> finalize autorecovery headroom and safe-mode.

lee (infra): uploading debug artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-debug/gw-tn-54/7259998888/ (coredump, nv-dump, logs). created ticket INF-7291 linking artifacts.

maria (support): thanks — keep me posted, i'll loop in account execs if Acme asks for compensation or incident report.

ryan (oncall): will post a short postmortem outline once we have the debug results. closing immediate incident once p95 errors drop under normal.

sre-bot: resolved alert: upstream-runner pool=nearline-prod host=gw-tn-54 status=drained at=7259998940

maria (support): p95 errors back to baseline, customers reporting reduced retries. closing channel for now, will reopen if we see a regression. :white_check_mark:
